bioconda.name: ldak
bioconda.summary: Heritability estimation, association testing and polygenic prediction from genome-wide SNP data
bioconda.description:
LDAK estimates SNP heritability, heritability enrichments and genetic
correlations from individual-level data or summary statistics (SumHer),
performs mixed-model and gene-based association testing (LDAK-KVIK,
LDAK-GBAT), and constructs polygenic scores (MegaPRS). This build links
conda-forge BLAS/LAPACK rather than Intel MKL.

commands: ldak 2>&1 | grep "LDAK - Software for obtaining Linkage Disequilibrium Adjusted Kinships"
ldak --help 2>&1 | grep "Here is a list of main arguments"
